{{Quote|My name is Tlinetha. And I like your anger. It has a pleasant heat.|Tlinetha to Jax Pavan|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
'''Tlinetha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] who worked as a [[Waiter/Legends|barmaid]] in the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Tlinetha was also an associate of [[Tyno Fabris]], an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Tlinetha acted as a go-between while the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] engaged in dealings with Fabris to obtain details of the location of the captured resistance leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]]. Tlinetha took a liking to Pavan and she attempted to flirt with him on a number of occasions, but he rejected her advances.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Look, why don't you go find yourself a seat and I'll bring you your caf.''"<br />"''That's not necessary.''"<br />"''That's my job. The bar guys get snippy when patrons clog up the serving area.|Tlinetha and Jax Pavan|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]], Tlinetha lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign. She made a living working as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] in the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]],<ref name="TLJ" /> the oldest [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], located in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]. Tlinetha became an associate of [[Tyno Fabris]], an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in service to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who frequented the ''Oyu'baat''. Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], she was commissioned as a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|paid]] intermediate between Fabris and the undercover [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-in-hiding [[Jax Pavan]], while the later dealt with the Black [[Star/Legends|Sun]] lieutenant in search of information on the location of the captured [[Whiplash]] resistance leader, [[Thi Xon Yimmon]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Tlinetha attempted to flirt with Pavan, but her efforts were rebuked.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Tlinetha was a slender Balosar female, with lavender-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Hair/Legends|hair]], the latter of which was intricately braided. She was taller than average for a Balosar, possessed of pale skin and a sultry, velvety voice. Tlinetha was kind to her customers, and openly flirtatious; she took a liking to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Jax Pavan during his first visit to the ''Oyu'baat'' and attempted to flirt with him on a number of occasions, but her advances were repeatedly turned down.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tlinetha first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the novel [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], co-written by [[Author/Legends|authors]] [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]], and published [[February 26]], [[2013]].
